title: PSG-21 Adaptive Imported STL Physical Coating Inset
visual_intent: A fresh purpose-built curved urn is imported from STL. One irregular plaster failure is adaptively refined and physically recessed into a separate derived shell, while a dedicated topology view proves that two independent selected regions remain two valid inset loops.
expected_visual_signal: The hero and grazing views must reveal real parallax, self-occlusion, a distinct transition wall, and a recessed floor. The role, provenance, depth-delta, and multi-region views must explain the generated adaptive topology.
rejection_condition: Reject if the result is material-only, adaptive refinement does not reduce boundary-edge scale to its deterministic target, either selected region is discarded, the source mesh changes, any derived edge is open or nonmanifold, repeat artifacts differ, or wall and floor roles cannot be distinguished.
